description.fallback: Sasuke reads a note from Sakura with her findings about Hoshinarabe; the card "Bonfire", for example, corresponds to a constellation visible in the ninth month. That night, Jiji accurately predicts that Menō will pass by their cell. Using a stick from a tree that he's seen Menō rest under, Jiji lures Menō close enough to pet and invites his cellmates to join him.
